verdict.rationale: Muse is a consumer personal-agent app, so real-time voice conversation is a fair axis. The evidence only shows text-style messaging: chatting in the Muse app on mobile or Mac, or in WhatsApp, 'the same way you message with other people.' Nothing documents voice input or output, let alone a natural real-time voice conversation mode.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
